title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Whether the Act of a Serviceman Deserting the Armed Forces in Non-Wartime Can Be Convicted and Punished

articles.content_en:
Military Court and Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army:

Your Request for Instructions, [1999] Jun Fa Cheng Zi No. 19, regarding whether the act of a serviceman deserting the unit during peacetime under aggravating circumstances may be convicted and punished under the Criminal Law, has been received. Upon deliberation, we hereby reply as follows:

Where a serviceman violates military service regulations by deserting the unit during peacetime under aggravating circumstances, the offense shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 435, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law.

This is in reply.
